text:
nina: Quick sync — consolidating pilot asks into a narrow MVP for private deploys. Customers keep asking for: deterministic egress, a frictionless installer, and clear upgrade guarantees. Need to lock acceptance criteria today.

gareth: Agreed. Suggest we label the MVP as 'netops-lite': (1) static egress binding (single IP or /32 pool), (2) zero-touch installer with preflight that returns actionable remediation, (3) signed airgap bundle + in-place upgrades, (4) BYOK for at-rest with strict access doc. No BGP/dynamic peering in MVP.

olivia: Engineering note: two implementation modes for egress binding: operator relay (we host small proxy) vs customer SNAT. Relay ships faster for NATed sites but is an extra operational component and adds latency. SNAT avoids hairpin but requires netops changes. We should support both and default to relay for quick wins.

praj: Security/legal: BYOK must ensure keys never leave customer control. For MVP we support single-key per-tenant BYOK with manual rotation. No multi-region or CMK federation. Legal wants a short explainer on key lifecycle and who can request access.

ci-bot: CI: operator-bundle build 2026-07-11-5. smoke tests: 19/22 passed. failing: windows preflight port-check flaky (icmp/udp).

tom: UX ask: Console needs a single "Network readiness" card showing mode (relay/SNAT), pinned egress IP(s), preflight status (ok/warn/fail) and one CTA: "Resolve network" which expands into a checklist with copy for netops. Keep it simple — reuse hosted checklist patterns.

helena: Rollout proposal: dogfood -> 2 invited pilots -> GA. Gates: smoke pass, preflight reliability > 95% in staging, perf within SLO for relay (p95 added latency < 200ms), and signed ops runbook.

nina: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Preflight returns explicit remediation for each failure (example: "ALLOW outbound 203.0.113.7:443 from installer host"); 2) Installer can pin egress and persist config across upgrades; 3) Airgap bundle signature + manifest validated; 4) BYOK flow documented and tested with one pilot; 5) Telemetry parity: token-level latency and cost traces retained 7 days in compact mode.

gareth: Perf note: relay latency varies by region. Engineering will publish a small matrix (us-west +60ms, eu-west +90ms, apac +120ms). We should add a config knob for per-tenant latency threshold and an automatic local-model fallback when breached.

olivia: Upgrade constraints: in-place bundle upgrades + offline bundle for airgapped installs. Must guarantee pinned egress does not change during upgrade. Also require a tested rollback path (bundle revert + config restore). Include a --dry-run option for the installer.

praj: Compliance ask: for airgapped customers we must provide a signed manifest tied to the bundle checksum and a reproducible build artifact. Security will require an attestation doc.

ci-bot: Test run: upgrade smoke: 15/16 passed. failing: post-upgrade KMS handshake times out intermittently in staging.

tom: Small developer ergonomics item: preflight should return machine-readable output (JSON) and a human view. Sample CLI:
```
redwoodctl preflight --target 10.0.8.12 --check-ports 443,22 --format json
```
Output should include remediation hints.

helena: For pilots we must narrow comms. Messaging idea: "Minimal networking surface with deterministic outbound behavior — quick installs for netops-lite sites. Planned Q3 enhancements: dynamic peering, per-tenant proxy, BGP support." Keep commitments tight.

nina: Action items (owners/deadlines): 1) olivia -> relay PoC + perf matrix by Thu; 2) olivia + infra -> fix windows preflight flake by Wed; 3) tom -> Console mock + copy for Network readiness card by Tue; 4) praj -> BYOK sample config + legal explainer by Mon; 5) helena -> draft pilot comms + FAQ by Tue; 6) ci-bot -> run upgrade e2e and surface failures by Fri.

gareth: Add to backlog: per-tenant feature flag for egress mapping, and telemetry toggle for 7-day compact retention.

olivia: Slight ask: add an explicit SLA note in runbook for relay mode (we'll own relay uptime for pilot customers otherwise pilots will want bigger guarantees).

nina: Noted. We'll keep SLA minimal for pilot and outline premium SLA options for Dedicated customers. Ok folks, I'll drop this into the private-deploy roadmap doc, assign the tickets, and ping owners. :thumbsup:
